verdict.rationale: A keyless probe found the main guidance site, www.sos.state.mn.us, behind a Radware Bot Manager CAPTCHA interstitial. The mblsportal.sos.mn.gov business and liens portal was reachable and crawled, so only part of the public reading surface is open to a keyless agent. Missing for 10: bot-wall-free access to the primary sos.state.mn.us guidance pages, evidence that the portal pages are not JS-only shells, and repeated or independent reachability checks with an identified user agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: mblsportal.sos.mn.gov remains the open surface and is part of this product's crawled corpus.
